suite: annotate face suggestions (candidate colours, the pick, the switch)
expect_red: ...and the solid body survives the next suggestion run -- the suggestion display asks what See-through says, it never decides

mutations.contract: Translucency has ONE owner -- the `transparency` verb and its See-through parts checkbox. The face-suggestion display asks for whatever that says and never forces it, so both switches are live at once and each does its own job.
mutations.note: This is not a hypothetical: the first build of the suggestion display faded the suggested body unconditionally, and this tier is what caught it. The witnessing sub-check is the one that RE-RUNS the suggestion after the switch is unticked, and that is the whole finding here -- the first version of the guard only unticked the switch, which the mutated build still honoured, because nothing had re-run `suggest` yet. A display state has to be checked after the thing that draws it runs again, not only after the setting changes.
